meta.notes: the whole registry and its derived key lists. Inputs are JSON and each case is recomputed from them; a raise is stored as {"raises": {"type", "message"}} (pydantic: "errors" instead of "message"). Polars frames are {columns, dtypes, rows}; pandas frames add index and write NA/NaN/NaT as null. Prices: close is adjusted, close_raw is the exchange print (house rule 6). Regenerate with `.venv/bin/python ../tools/parity/golden_ranking.py` from decile-blueprint.

output.REGIME_PRIORITY_SQL: (CASE regime WHEN 'BULL' THEN 2 WHEN 'NEUTRAL' THEN 1 WHEN 'BEAR' THEN 0 END)

factors.definition: 0-21 points: 4 for each moving average the close is above, 5 more for a full 20 > 50 > 100 > 200 stack.
factors.label: MA STACK SCORE
factors.sql_expr: CASE WHEN close IS NOT NULL AND ma_20 IS NOT NULL AND ma_50 IS NOT NULL AND ma_100 IS NOT NULL AND ma_200 IS NOT NULL THEN (CASE WHEN close > ma_20 THEN 4 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN close > ma_50 THEN 4 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN close > ma_100 THEN 4 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN close > ma_200 THEN 4 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN close > ma_20 AND ma_20 > ma_50 AND ma_50 > ma_100 AND ma_100 > ma_200 THEN 5 ELSE 0 END) END
